title: Debts
intro: Sales where the goods left against a promise to pay. The debt falls as cash arrives; profit is recognized once the cost has been recovered.

collect.title: Credit payment #{{id}}
collect.hint: {{customer}} still owes {{amount}}. Part payments are accepted.

waive.title: Waive debt #{{id}}
waive.hint: The remaining {{amount}} is written off. No cash arrives — the unrecovered cost is booked as a loss.
waive.reasonHint: Required. This moves the balance sheet, so the reason stays on the record.
waive.confirm: Waive {{customer}}'s remaining {{amount}}? This cannot be undone.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.amountExceeds: The payment cannot exceed the remaining debt ({{balance}}).
errors.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for waiving the debt.

create.title: New debt
create.intro: Money lent with no sale behind it. Cash leaves the till and the same amount appears as a debt — the balance sheet does not move.
create.cashNote: This amount leaves the till. It comes back when the debt is repaid. Profit is not affected either way.
create.confirm: Lend {{amount}}? This amount leaves the till.
create.errAmount: Enter the amount in som, in dollars, or in both.
create.errBothCurrencies: A debt is lent in one currency. Enter som or dollars, not both.
